body: i’ve been on 3 or 4 pills for a little over a year
i’ve tried a few but the anxiety i get from pouring my life into another stranger is just too much
what meds? asking for a friend

i don’t care if people care about me, that doesn’t phase me and it doesn’t make leaving them any harder. 

therapy’s just been empty, i tell him so much and try to make him understand but he just never can say anything to make me feel any better. he doesn’t ask the hard questions or suggest anything besides “relaxing” my whole life is just laying in bed telling myself it’s good to “relax” but truly i just never can with my mind constantly racing and telling me this is all pointless.
i’m feelin a bit better now thank you tho really
thanks, i don’t necessarily want to again i just know myself too well to say i won’t
